22168.name: Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies A Windswept Cell.

west.description: To the west lies A Chamber Of Hooks.

22168.description:
The passage is cut through black rock here, leading north deeper into
Ocam's Reach and south back toward the castle. Doorways open east and
west, and through each comes the howl of the wind from slits in the
promontory's face. Barbed iron hooks glint in rows beyond them. Here,
between the two, the air is strangely still.

22001.name: Pathway To The Lost Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To The Lost Castle.

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies The Entrance Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

22001.description:
A vaulted passage of black stone runs beneath the castle's outer works,
its roof lost in a darkness no torch has warmed in an age. To the north
the floor drops away into a tangle of braced sticks, the old way toward
the Lost Castle. An iron-bound door in the south wall gives onto the
entrance chambers, while the pathway around the castle leads off east
and west through low arches crusted with ash. The air is still and
smells of cold iron.

14102.name: The Entrance Chambers

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To The Lost Castle.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14102.description:
The entrance chambers open into a broad room of black stone, its ceiling
held up by squat pillars bound in iron bands. Heavy doors stand to the
north, where the dark passage leads out toward the pathway and the Lost
Castle. Halls run off east and west along the inner wall, and to the
south a wide arch opens on the Inner Hall. Burned banners hang in
tatters from the pillars, and the floor is scored by countless iron-shod
feet.

22003.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22003.description:
A narrow path hugs the outer wall, littered with ancient rubble and
shattered bone. The stone underfoot is slick with mold and ash. A chill
wind scrapes along the passage.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies The Entrance Chambers.

14104.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14104.description:
This hall runs straight along the inner face of the castle wall, low-
roofed and narrow, its stones sweating a cold damp. Iron sconces line
the wall at regular intervals, every one of them empty and furred with
rust. Mold spreads in pale grey blooms along the seams of the floor. The
hall continues east and west into gloom.

14105.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14105.description:
The hall widens slightly around a stone bench set into the wall, its
seat worn hollow by long-dead sentries. Above it someone has scratched a
tally into the stone, hundreds of marks in rows until the last line
breaks off unfinished. The smell of old ash hangs heavy in the air.
Narrow passages lead on east and west.

extra_descs.tally marks scratches:
The marks are grouped in fives, row after row, scratched with a knife
point into the black stone. The last row ends in a single long gouge
that runs off the edge of the tally and down the wall.

22004.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22004.description:
The path narrows between crumbling blocks and jutting iron spikes.
Shadows pool in every crevice. The wall looms overhead, blotting out the
sky.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14107.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

up.description: To the up lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14107.description:
A spiral stair climbs out of the corner of this hall, its steps cracked
and slick, rising up toward the ragged walkway atop the castle. A thin
draught falls down the stairwell, carrying the moan of wind from the
battlements. The hall itself turns here, running west along the wall and
south into deeper shadow. Rusted chains hang from the ceiling at the
foot of the stair, swaying a little in the draught.

22005.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22005.description:
Rubble chokes the path here, forcing careful steps. The wall is scarred
by old siege damage. A faint metallic tang hangs in the air. The air is
thick and hard to breathe. The floor is slick with moisture.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14109.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14109.description:
The hall runs straight and narrow, the inner wall on one side and a row
of arrow-loops on the other, every shutter nailed fast. Bones have been
swept into a heap against the foot of the wall, as though someone meant
to clear them and never came back. The stone floor slopes gently as the
hall runs south, and climbs north toward the stair.

22006.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22006.description:
The wall curves sharply, its stone cold and slick with condensation.
Darkness gathers in the corners. The silence is oppressive and watchful.
The floor is slick with moisture. The air is thick and hard to breathe.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14111.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14111.description:
Water seeps down the wall here in thin black streaks, pooling in a
shallow channel cut along the floor. The channel is choked with rust-red
sludge and smells of iron and rot. A broken halberd is bolted to the
wall as a trophy, its blade notched in some forgotten battle. The hall
runs north and south, its far ends lost in the dark.

14112.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14112.description:
A great iron grille is set into the ceiling of this stretch, and through
it falls a faint grey light from somewhere far above. The light shows
walls blackened by fire and a floor strewn with the brittle remains of
shields, their devices long since burned away. The hall continues north,
and south it narrows toward a darker stretch where the air turns stale
and close.

22007.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22007.description:
The wind dies against the massive wall. Shadows pool between fallen
blocks and shattered masonry. The air tastes of dust and decay. The air
is thick and hard to breathe. Darkness clings to every surface.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22155.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

east.description: To the east lies A Floor Of Rotten Planks.

22155.description:
The black hall runs north and south here along the inner wall. To the
east a doorway opens over a floor of rotten planks laid across a pit,
and they groan in the draught. From the depths below rises a stench of
old death and the faint glint of upturned blades. The hall's own
flagstones are sound.

22008.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22008.description:
The hall turns here at a corner of the castle, where a stair climbs
through a broken hatch to the walkway atop the wall. Collapsed masonry,
charred and cracked, lies heaped against the outer side. West the hall
runs on along the inner wall, and north it goes on into darkness over
sounder stones. Cold air spills down the stairwell.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

up.description: To the up lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14116.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14116.description:
The hall turns along the wall here, and the stonework changes to great
rough blocks stacked without mortar, each one larger than a cart. The
gaps between them have been packed with bone, skulls and thighbones
wedged tight to hold the courses level. The air is cold and utterly
still. The way runs east toward a heap of charred masonry and west into
deeper dark.

22025.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22025.description:
A sickly, sweetish reek fills this dark stretch of hall, thick enough to
taste. Mold grows in heavy furred carpets over floor and walls alike,
and in places it has swallowed shapes that might once have been bodies.
Dead flies lie in drifts along the foot of the wall. The hall runs east
toward cleaner stone and west into a blackness that seems to wait.

22178.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies The Hall Of Spikes.

22178.description:
The hall runs east toward its far end and west along the inner wall. To
the south a side passage opens, its walls pierced with hundreds of small
holes, and from each one the point of an iron spike glints in whatever
light you carry. Somewhere within the stone, great counterweights shift
with a groan. The floor of the hall itself is solid and dry.

22159.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies The Creeping Walls.

22159.description:
The hall runs on east and west here, wide enough for two to walk
abreast. In its south wall a narrow passage opens between stones stained
dark at about the height of a man's chest. A slow grinding comes from
inside it, and dust sifts from its lintel. The flagstones before it are
scratched where something was pulled away.

22026.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22026.description:
A scorched hall runs deeper into the keep. The stone is blackened and
slick with soot. The air carries the faint sting of smoke that never
burns out.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22161.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

north.description: To the north lies Under The Iron Slab.

22161.description:
The hall runs east to a scorched passage and west along the inner wall.
To the north opens a low chamber whose ceiling is a single slab of iron
hung on chains, and it hangs lower than it should. A chain groans
somewhere overhead. Scraps of crushed armour lie at its threshold.

22179.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22179.description:
The black hall runs east and west along the inner wall. In its southern
side stands an iron door, tall and narrow and shaped like a man, its
face studded with rivets and its hinges oiled bright. It stands ajar.
The stones before it are worn into a groove by things dragged inside.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies The Iron Maiden.

22104.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22104.description:
Beyond the iron maiden the hall grows quiet again, though the dark here
is total and the air is cold enough to ache in the teeth. Old blood has
dried in a long smear along the floor, running from the east as if
something was dragged this way. The walls bear the soot of torches that
burned out long ago. The hall carries on west toward a grey glimmer of
light.

14124.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14124.description:
Grey light leaks into this part of the hall through a high crack in the
wall, enough to show the full ruin of the place. Fallen ceiling stones
lie where they dropped, and among them the rusted rim of a war-wagon
wheel leans against the wall. Ash drifts in through the crack and
settles over everything like fine grey flour. The hall runs east into
the dark and west toward a bend in the wall.

22014.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22014.description:
A sheer wall ends the path, its surface unmarked and impassable. The
dead end feels like a judgment. There is nothing here but dust and
silence.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

up.description: To the up lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14126.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14126.description:
The hall runs straight along the inner wall here, its floor paved with
slabs carved long ago with the sigils of the four horsemen: a crown, a
sword, a scale and a skull. Most have been worn almost smooth by passing
feet. A cold draught moves steadily from north to south as though the
castle itself were breathing. The way runs north into shadow and south
to a bend in the wall.

extra_descs.sigils slabs crown sword scale skull:
Four sigils are carved in turn into the floor slabs: a crown for plague,
a sword for war, a scale for hunger and a skull for the end of all
things. Where feet have not worn them away, the grooves are still
stained dark.

22013.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22013.description:
Crumbling blocks form a jagged corridor beside the wall. The footing is
treacherous and uneven. The shadows seem to move at the edge of vision.
Darkness clings to every surface. The air is thick and hard to breathe.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14128.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14128.description:
Shattered weapon racks line this length of the hall, their pegs empty,
their timbers split and blackened. A heap of broken arrow shafts lies in
one corner, the fletching long since rotted to nothing. The air smells
faintly of old oil and older blood. The hall runs on north and south
between the racks.

14129.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14129.description:
A crack runs the full height of the inner wall here, and through it
seeps a faint red glow and a warmth that feels wrong in so cold a place.
The stone around the crack is blistered and glassy. Ash lies in a fan
across the floor beneath it. The hall continues north along the wall and
south past a row of broken weapon racks.

22012.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22012.description:
The path turns along the wall, the stone worn smooth by countless feet.
The darkness deepens ahead. A faint wind carries the scent of rot. The
floor is slick with moisture. The stone walls press close, cold and
damp.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14131.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14131.description:
Chains are strung across this part of the hall at head height, hung with
the dented helms of fallen knights like grim bells. When the draught
stirs, they knock together with a hollow, tuneless sound. The floor
beneath is gritty with flakes of rust. The hall leads north toward a
bitter cold and south along the curve of the wall.

22011.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22011.description:
The air is colder here, the wall radiating a dead chill that seeps into
bone. Frost rimes the lower stones. The silence is absolute and final.
The silence is oppressive and watchful. Darkness clings to every
surface.

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14133.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

up.description: To the up lies Ragged Walkway Atop The Castle.

14133.description:
A narrow stair is cut into the thickness of the wall here, climbing up
toward the ragged walkway that runs along the castle's top. The hall
turns at its foot, running east along the wall and south into a chill
that bites through any cloak. The steps are worn to a dip in the middle,
and a thin whine of wind comes down them from above. Bones lie wedged in
the angle of the stair, as if someone fell there and was never moved.

22010.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall
22010.description:
The wall rises sheer here, its surface etched with claw marks deep
enough to fit a fist. Something massive once climbed here. The scratches
are old but still sharp.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14135.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14135.description:
This stretch of hall is lined with tall niches, each holding the rusted
shell of a suit of armour bolted upright to the stone. The helms are
empty, but every visor has been turned to face the passage. The hall
runs east along the wall and west toward a face of stone gouged by
enormous claws. Dust lies thick and undisturbed in the niches.

14136.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

14136.description:
The hall here is hung with the war trophies of some ancient victory:
shields nailed to the wall in rows, each one split clean through by a
single blow. Beneath them a long stone table runs the length of the
passage, bare but for a film of ash. The hall leads east toward the
entrance chambers and west past a line of armoured niches. A faint cold
wind sighs along the floor.

22002.name: Hall Along The Inner Wall

east.description: To the east lies The Entrance Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22002.description:
The hall is black as pitch here, and the walls lean so close that they
seem to listen. A low arch to the east opens onto the entrance chambers,
the only break in the dark. Something has gouged long furrows into the
floor, running west into the blackness where the hall carries on along
the inner wall. The air is cold and tastes of rust.

22009.name: The Inner Hall
22009.description:
A narrow path skirts the outer wall, strewn with broken stone and rusted
metal. The wall rises sheer overhead. Each step echoes in the stillness.
Darkness clings to every surface. The stone walls press close, cold and
damp.

north.description: To the north lies The Entrance Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies The Junction Of The Inner Halls.

14139.name: The Junction Of The Inner Halls

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Hall.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Inner Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Inner Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14139.description:
Four ways meet in this high, square chamber beneath a ceiling ribbed
with blackened iron. A great brazier of bone and bronze stands cold in
the centre, its bowl full of grey ash. The Inner Hall opens both to the
north and to the south, while the inner corridor runs off east and west.
The walls are hung with burned banners whose devices can no longer be
read.

14140.name: Along The Inner Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Along The Inner Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Junction Of The Inner Halls.

14140.description:
The inner corridor is narrow and high, its walls rising into darkness
where iron hooks dangle from the vault on lengths of chain. The floor is
laid with black flags, polished smooth along a single worn track down
the middle. To the west lies the junction of the inner halls, and to the
east the corridor grows darker still. A low, steady draught carries the
smell of cold ash.

22020.name: Along The Inner Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Along The Inner Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Inner Corridor.

22020.description:
No light reaches this stretch of the inner corridor, and the dark seems
to soak up sound as well. Underfoot, brittle things crunch with every
step, too many and too small to be stones. The walls are cold and
faintly greasy to the touch. The corridor runs on east and west, its
ends invisible.

14142.name: Along The Inner Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Guard Room.

east.description: To the east lies End Of The Inner Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14142.description:
The inner corridor widens here beside a heavy iron-banded doorway that
opens north into a guard room. Spikes have been set into the door's
frame point-outward, and old ash is trodden into the floor before it. To
the east the corridor runs a short way further to its end, and to the
west it stretches back into blackness. A rusted lantern hook juts from
the wall, long empty.

22021.name: End Of The Inner Corridor

west.description: To the west lies Along The Inner Corridor.

22021.description:
The inner corridor ends here against a wall of fused black stone, smooth
as glass and warm to the touch, as if it had once run like wax. Nothing
is carved on it and nothing breaks its face. The darkness is complete,
and the silence is so deep that your own heartbeat sounds loud. The only
way out lies back to the west.

22100.name: Guard Room
22100.description:
A narrow trail veers into brutal stonework and jagged spikes. Bones lie
half‑buried in ash, their edges polished smooth. The path coils with a
sense of malice.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14145.name: Along The Inner Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Junction Of The Inner Halls.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14145.description:
The inner corridor runs straight and narrow between walls of fitted
black stone, its ceiling lost in shadow overhead. Eastward the passage
opens onto the junction of the inner halls, where several ways meet. To
the west the corridor stretches on, lit by iron cressets set in the wall
at long intervals. Flakes of burned banner cloth crunch underfoot like
dead leaves.

14146.name: Along The Inner Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Along The Inner Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14146.description:
Here the corridor's walls are studded with iron spikes driven into the
mortar at the height of a man's chest, so that the middle of the floor
is the only safe place to walk. A thin wind moans along the passage from
somewhere far off, carrying the smell of ash. The corridor leads on east
and west, its flagstones cracked and heaved. Old scorch marks blacken
the stone in long streaks.

14147.name: Along The Inner Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Guard Room.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Inner Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies End Of The Inner Corridor.

14147.description:
The corridor widens a little at a heavy doorway set in its north wall,
its lintel carved with a row of grinning skulls. Beyond the door lies a
guard room, its threshold worn hollow by generations of boots. East the
corridor runs back toward the inner halls, and west it narrows toward
its end. A rack bolted to the wall here holds nothing now but rust and
dust.

14148.name: Guard Room

south.description: To the south lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14148.description:
This low guard room is cramped and smoky, its single brazier long gone
cold beneath a crust of ash. A battered table stands in the middle,
ringed by stools of bone and iron, and a game board has been scratched
deep into its top. Weapon racks along the walls stand empty, their pegs
snapped off. The only door leads back south into the inner corridor.

14149.name: End Of The Inner Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Along The Inner Corridor.

14149.description:
The inner corridor ends abruptly against a wall of rubble, where a
ceiling vault has come down in a heap of black stone and broken bone.
Iron spikes jut from the debris at crooked angles like the ribs of some
great carcass. Cold air seeps between the stones, smelling faintly of
earth and decay. The only way onward is back east along the corridor.

14150.name: The Inner Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Junction Of The Inner Halls.

south.description: To the south lies The Guardian Chambers.

14150.description:
The Inner Hall is a long, lofty chamber whose roof is lost above a
thicket of iron chains hung with the bones of men and beasts. Its floor
is a mosaic of black and red stone, cracked and heaved but still showing
the shape of a vast rider on a pale horse. A massive door of bone-white
wood bound in iron stands to the south, and to the north the hall opens
onto the junction of the inner halls. The air is cold enough to steam
the breath.

extra_descs.mosaic rider horse floor:
The rider in the mosaic is drawn in black stone on a horse of pale bone-
coloured tiles, a long blade held low at its side. Red tiles spread from
the horse's hooves like spilled blood, and many of them have been prised
up and carried off.

14151.name: The Guardian Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The Inner Hall.

east.description: To the east lies The Guardian Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies Entry-Way To The Lair Of Death.

west.description: To the west lies The Guardian Chambers.

14151.description:
The guardian chambers begin here in a broad stone room ringed with empty
pedestals, as though statues once stood watch and simply walked away. A
door of black iron, graven with a skull, stands closed to the south.
Archways lead east and west into further chambers, and the Inner Hall
lies back to the north. Gouges in the floor around each pedestal show
where great weight has shifted many times.

14152.name: Entry-Way To The Lair Of Death

north.description: To the north lies The Guardian Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies The Gates To Hell.

14152.description:
A narrow, steep-walled passage runs on from the skull-graven door toward
the lair of Death, and every stone in it is cold as a grave. The walls
are set with niches holding skulls, row upon row, their empty sockets
turned toward the passage. A heavy door of blackened iron waits to the
south, hot to the touch despite the chill. The guardian chambers lie
back to the north.

14153.name: The Gates To Hell

north.description: To the north lies Entry-Way To The Lair Of Death.

14153.description:
Two immense gates of black iron fill the end of this chamber, twice the
height of any castle door and wrought with writhing figures that seem to
move at the corner of the eye. A dull red glow beats behind them like a
slow heart, and heat rolls from their seams in waves. The gates are
sealed fast by chains as thick as a man's leg. The only way back is
north, through the iron door into the entry-way.

extra_descs.gates figures iron:
The figures wrought into the gates are men and women caught in endless
falling, their mouths open and their hands reaching up. Look too long
and they seem to slip a little further down the iron.

14154.name: The Guardian Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Guardian Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Guardian Chambers.

14154.description:
This chamber is long and bare, its walls lined with deep alcoves that
hold nothing but shadow and dust. The floor between them is scattered
with shattered bone and the splintered remains of shields. Torch
brackets of twisted iron jut from the walls, black with old soot. The
chambers run on east, and west back toward the skull-graven door.

14155.name: The Guardian Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Guardian Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Guardian Chambers.

14155.description:
A pair of colossal iron gauntlets is set into the wall here, palms open
and fingers curled, each large enough to close around a man. Chains run
from their wrists into the stone. The floor before them is cracked in a
wide ring, as if something heavy has dropped there again and again. The
chambers continue east and west through low, square doorways.

14156.name: The Guardian Chambers

south.description: To the south lies The Guardian Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Guardian Chambers.

14156.description:
The guardian chambers turn here, the passage bending in from the west
and running on south into a deeper dark. Burned banners hang in a row
along the wall, every one scorched into a ragged triangle. The stone
floor is gritty with ash and fragments of bone, and the cold seems to
come up through it. A single iron spike has been driven deep into the
floor at the turn, its head worn bright by passing hands.

22022.name: The Guardian Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The Guardian Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies The End Of The Guardian Chambers.

22022.description:
This chamber lies in utter darkness, the walls rough and the ceiling so
low it seems to press down on the crown of your head. A smell of mold
and old iron hangs in the stale air. Bones crowd the corners, heaped as
high as a man's waist. The way leads north toward the bannered turn of
the chambers and south to the last of them.

14158.name: The End Of The Guardian Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The Guardian Chambers.

14158.description:
The guardian chambers end in a high, round room whose walls are carved
floor to ceiling with armoured warriors kneeling in rows. Every kneeling
figure has had its face chiselled away. In the centre of the floor a
broad disc of iron is sunk flush with the stone, marked with a single
handprint burned into the metal. The only way out leads back north into
the dark.

extra_descs.disc iron handprint:
The iron disc is as wide as a cartwheel and cold as the deep earth. The
handprint burned into its centre is too long in the fingers to be a
man's, and the metal around it is blistered as if from a great heat.

14159.name: The Guardian Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Guardian Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Guardian Chambers.

14159.description:
This chamber is bare stone from floor to ceiling, except for a long row
of iron hooks along one wall where shields once hung. Their shapes still
show as pale ovals on the soot-darkened stone. The air is colder here
and very still. Archways lead east to the chamber of empty pedestals and
west to further guardian chambers.

14160.name: The Guardian Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Guardian Chambers.

west.description: To the west lies The Guardian Chambers.

14160.description:
The ceiling of this guardian chamber has partly fallen, and a slope of
broken stone and bone fills one side of the room almost to the vault. A
path has been cleared through the rubble, stamped hard by heavy feet.
From somewhere above comes the faint, endless whisper of wind. The
chambers continue east and west, the way west dim and choked with dust.

14161.name: The Guardian Chambers

east.description: To the east lies The Guardian Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies The Guardian Chambers.

14161.description:
Iron braziers on tall tripods burn with a low, greenish flame, throwing
the shadows of bone pillars across the floor. The chamber is square and
high, its black stone walls hung with shields hacked nearly in two. A
broad arch opens east into more of the guardian chambers, while a
narrower passage slopes away south into deeper gloom. Ash drifts in the
corners like grey snow that never melts.

22101.name: The Guardian Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The Guardian Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies The Guardian Chambers.

22101.description:
No flame burns in this chamber, and the dark seems to press against the
eyes like a cold hand. Footsteps ring on iron plates bolted over the
floor, each one stamped with a skull worn smooth by passing boots. The
walls sweat a black, oily damp that smells of rust and old blood. The
passage carries on north toward the lit chambers and south into a last,
closed-in room.

14163.name: The Guardian Chambers

north.description: To the north lies The Guardian Chambers.

14163.description:
The guardian chambers end here in a cramped room of black stone with
only one way out, back north. Rows of iron hooks line the walls, and
from a few still hang the rotted straps of armour long since taken down.
A stone bench runs along the far wall, its surface scored with tally
marks scratched by some long-dead watcher. The air is stale and still.

extra_descs.tally marks bench:
Hundreds of short scratches are cut into the bench in groups of five,
row upon row. The last group is unfinished, its final stroke trailing
off into a long, wavering gouge.

14200.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To The Lost Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14200.description:
A path of broken flagstones skirts the foot of the castle's black outer
wall, which rises sheer and windowless overhead. Under a sky the colour
of old ash, a cold wind drives grit along the stones. East a fainter
track branches off through the rubble toward the Lost Castle, while the
pathway around the castle follows the wall west. Rusted iron spikes
crown the battlements far above.

14201.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14201.description:
The pathway runs on between the castle wall and a steep drop strewn with
fallen masonry. Bones lie half-buried in the ash along the edge,
bleached grey by wind and time. Thin clouds race low over the
battlements, and no bird calls anywhere. The way leads east and west
along the wall.

14202.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14202.description:
A burned banner hangs from an iron pole jammed between two flagstones,
its cloth reduced to black tatters that snap in the wind. The castle
wall here is pocked with old scars where siege stones struck it and
failed. Ash lies ankle-deep in the hollows of the path, which runs on to
the east and west. The air tastes of smoke, though no fire burns.

14203.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14203.description:
The path dips into a shallow trough where rainwater has pooled, black
and still, reflecting a bruised sky. Rust stains streak down the castle
wall above it from a row of iron rings set high in the stone. The
pathway climbs out again to the east and west, its edges crumbling. A
deep silence hangs over everything, broken only by the wind.

14204.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14204.description:
Here the wall bends, and the pathway follows it around the corner of a
squat tower whose arrow slits are dark and empty. Shattered weapons are
heaped against the tower's foot, a war trophy left to rust where it was
flung. East the path runs back along the wall, and west it continues
toward another turn. Ash swirls in small eddies at the tower's base.

14205.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To The Lost Castle.

14205.description:
The pathway hugs the foot of the castle wall, a ledge of cracked
flagstones scattered with bone splinters and windblown ash. Overhead the
sky is a low lid of grey cloud that never seems to move. The vaulted
passage toward the Lost Castle lies back to the west, and the path runs
on east beneath a line of iron spikes driven into the stone. Every gust
carries a faint taste of smoke.

14206.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14206.description:
Here the wall bellies outward over the path, its black blocks scorched
in long tongues as if great fires once licked up their face. A burned
banner hangs from a rusted bracket, nothing left of it but a blackened
rag that snaps in the wind. The flagstones are split and heaved, and the
path picks its way between them east and west. Somewhere above, a loose
shutter bangs without rhythm.

14207.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14207.description:
A row of pikes stands along the outer edge of the path, each crowned
with a weathered skull turned to face the castle. Beyond them the ground
falls away into a grey haze where nothing grows. The wall here bears a
deep crack wide enough to take an arm, and cold air breathes out of it.
The path continues east and west along the stones.

extra_descs.pikes skulls skull:
Each pike is a shaft of black iron sunk into the rock, and each skull is
fixed to its point with a twist of rusted wire. Some are human, some far
larger, and all of them stare at the castle wall as though waiting for
it to fall.

14208.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14208.description:
Ash lies ankle-deep on this stretch of the pathway, soft and grey and
marked by nothing at all. The wind lifts it in slow curls that drift
along the foot of the wall and settle again. Iron rings set into the
stonework at shoulder height still hold the rusted ends of chains, their
other ends long since gone. The way runs on east, and back west toward
the castle's dark passage.

14209.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14209.description:
A fallen buttress has spilled its blocks across half the path, leaving a
narrow gap between rubble and wall to squeeze through. Shattered bones
are mixed into the debris, old enough to have taken on the colour of the
stone. Far off, beyond the haze, a bell tolls once and falls silent. The
pathway runs east toward a turn in the wall and west along the castle's
flank.

14210.name: Pathway Around The Castle

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14210.description:
The pathway reaches a corner of the castle, where two great walls meet
in a tower of black stone that rises out of sight into the cloud. Arrow
slits stare down from its face, dark and empty. The path bends here,
running south along the next face of the wall and west back the way it
came. The wind is fiercer at the corner, moaning through the slits like
a voice.

14211.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14211.description:
Along this face of the castle the wall is studded with iron spikes, each
as long as a man's arm and red with rust. Scraps of cloth and leather
cling to some of them, faded to the grey of everything else. The pathway
runs north to the corner tower and south along the foot of the wall.
Underfoot the stones are slick with a dark, oily grime that never dries.

14212.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14212.description:
The pathway ends abruptly where a great slab of the wall has fallen
outward and buried the way beneath a mound of broken stone. Nothing lies
beyond the slab but grey haze and the endless wind. A charred standard
pole juts from the rubble, its banner burned away to a few blackened
threads. The only way on is north, back along the wall.

14214.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14214.description:
The pathway turns sharply here at the castle's corner, leaving the long
wall to the east and running south along the next face of the fortress.
A cairn of skulls, cemented together with black mortar, marks the bend
like a grim milestone. The wind is stronger at the corner, tugging at
cloaks and hair. Grey cloud hangs so low it seems to scrape the
battlements.

extra_descs.cairn skulls:
The skulls are stacked in a rough cone taller than a man, every one of
them facing outward. Some are cracked by blows, and a few still wear
rusted fragments of helm.

14215.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14215.description:
The path runs straight along the foot of the wall, hemmed in on the
other side by a ditch choked with rubble and charred timbers. Iron
spikes have been driven into the ditch's lip, points outward, rusted to
the colour of dried blood. The way goes on north toward the corner and
south beside the wall. Ash falls lightly from the sky in a slow grey
drift.

14216.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14216.description:
Flagstones give way here to packed black earth, cracked into plates by
drought and cold. A great iron chain hangs down the castle wall from
somewhere above, its lowest links buried in the ground. The pathway
leads north and south, following the line of the wall. The air is bitter
and dry, and it smells faintly of sulphur.

14217.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14217.description:
A crumbled buttress juts out from the wall, forcing the path to squeeze
between it and the edge of the drop beyond. Loose stones skitter away
underfoot and vanish without a sound. North and south the pathway runs
on, a little wider on either side. Above, the wind whistles through gaps
in the battlements like a mournful horn.

14218.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14218.description:
The ground is littered with shards of bone here, crushed so fine in
places that it crunches like gravel. A portcullis is set into the castle
wall, sealed shut long ago and fused by rust into the stone. The path
continues north and south along the fortress. Pale light leaks through
the clouds without any warmth in it.

14219.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14219.description:
Ahead the pathway plunges into the black mouth of a covered passage cut
through a jutting bastion, and the open sky ends at its lip. The stones
around the opening are blackened as if by a great fire. North the path
runs back along the open wall. A stale, cold draught breathes out of the
dark to the south, carrying a smell of rust.

22153.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies A Tilting Floor.

22153.description:
The pathway passes through the dark heart of a bastion here, roofed in
stone and close on every side. The floor is slick with black ooze that
seeps from a low opening to the west, and from beyond it comes the stink
of old death. Faint grey light marks the way north and an opening to the
south. Careful feet have kept to the far wall.

14221.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14221.description:
Between two bastions the pathway emerges briefly under the open sky, a
narrow ledge of cracked stone pinned against the castle wall. Ash-grey
cloud boils overhead, and a cold rain spits from it in fitful gusts.
Covered passages yawn at either end, one north and one south, both dark
as a throat. Scraps of rotted rope dangle from rings in the wall above.

22154.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies A Falling Ceiling.

22154.description:
A covered stretch of the pathway runs north and south here beneath a
roof of iron-banded stone. To the west a low doorway opens into a
chamber whose ceiling hangs lower still, and the grinding of hidden
chains sounds somewhere in its walls. Rubble lies heaped along the
footing. Dust sifts down in thin streams from the cracks above.

14223.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14223.description:
The pathway leaves the dark passage for grey daylight once more, running
beside the wall over ground heaped with fallen slates. A shattered siege
engine lies on its side against the wall, its timbers charred and its
throwing arm snapped. North the passage gapes black, and the path leads
south toward a meeting of ways. The wind carries the dry rattle of loose
slate.

extra_descs.siege engine:
It was a great throwing engine once, its frame of black oak bound with
iron. Fire has eaten most of it, and the stone it last loaded still sits
in the cup of its broken arm.

14224.name: Pathway Around The Castle

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

14224.description:
Several paths meet here on a flat of ash-covered stone at the castle's
foot. The pathway around the castle runs east along the wall and north
back toward the bastions, while a rougher track breaks away west toward
the high, wind-scoured promontory of Ocam's Reach. An iron post leans at
the junction, a skull nailed to its top as though to point the way. The
gale coming off the promontory is bitterly cold.

14225.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

14225.description:
The path narrows along a stretch of wall where great blocks have sheared
away, leaving the rubble core beneath exposed like a wound. Thorny black
weeds grow from the cracks, the only living thing in sight. West lies
the meeting of paths, and east the way disappears into another dark,
roofed passage. The sky above is heavy and bruised.

22176.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

south.description: To the south lies The Hall Of Blades.

22176.description:
The roofed passage runs east and west, utterly dark, the air warm and
wet with a sickly, sweet stench. To the south a side opening is crossed
by thin wires at ankle height, and dark slots gape in its walls. Old
stains blacken the stones before it. The way on keeps hard to the far
wall.

22105.name: Pathway Around The Castle

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

22105.description:
The passage continues in darkness beneath a vaulted roof, its walls
lined with iron brackets that once held lamps and now hold only soot.
Water drips steadily from somewhere overhead, each drop loud in the
silence. The passage leads east and west, its floor slick and uneven.
Scratches gouged low in the stone look like the marks of desperate
fingers.

22035.name: Pathway Around The Castle

west.description: To the west lies Pathway Around The Castle.

22035.description:
The covered pathway ends here at a wall of black stone sealed with iron
bands as thick as a man's arm. Nothing stirs in the darkness, and the
silence is so complete that the blood can be heard rushing in the ears.
A heap of broken shields and snapped spears has been piled against the
dead end like a trophy of some forgotten rout. The only way out lies
back west.

14229.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

14229.description:
The track toward Ocam's Reach climbs away from the castle wall across a
bare, wind-scoured slope of black rock. Nothing grows here, and the gale
shrieks unchecked, flinging grit and ash into the face. East the track
drops back to the meeting of paths below the castle, and west it enters
a dark, roofed cutting in the rock. Far off, the promontory juts out
against a leaden sky.

22177.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies A Hollow Floor.

22177.description:
The roofed cutting runs east and west through rough rock that sweats
cold water. On its south side the floor gives way to a square shaft
framed in rotten timber, its boards long since fallen in. The wind moans
across the shaft's mouth like a voice. A narrow ledge along the far wall
keeps the way dry.

22158.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

north.description: To the north lies The Iron-Plated Passage.

22158.description:
The passage runs east and west here between walls of rough stone. To the
north a side passage lined with plates of rusted iron, riveted edge to
edge, opens off the way, and the reek of old oil and rust drifts from
it. The plates nearest the opening are scored and pitted. Something in
the walls clanks now and then, as if waiting.

22106.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22106.description:
This stretch of the pathway is quieter, a vaulted hall of black stone
whose floor is strewn with ash and shards of pottery. West the hall
narrows toward a heavy door of bone and iron, and east it runs back into
the iron-plated passage. Faded paintings on the walls show four riders
beneath a burning sky, their colours long since flaked away. The cold
here seeps into the bones.

extra_descs.paintings riders:
Four riders gallop across the plaster, one on a white horse, one on red,
one on black and one on a pale, sickly grey. Beneath their hooves the
painted world burns.

22027.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach
22027.description:
A heavy door of bone and iron stands within a narrow hall. The metal is
cold and rough, the bone polished by countless hands. The silence here
feels deliberate and watchful.

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22160.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies The Chute Of Blades.

22160.description:
A short, crooked passage runs from the door of bone and iron to the
north and levels west toward another chamber. To the east the floor
drops away into a chute polished slick by something that oozes from the
walls. A sweet, rotten smell rises from it. Those who came before kept
close to the western wall.

22028.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22028.description:
This is a wide, low chamber where the dark is deeper than anywhere else,
so that even a torch seems to burn small and dim. The stone floor is
cold as a grave, and a fine grey dust lies over it untouched. South the
air grows hot and dry, and a low throb like a drum rolls up from that
way. East a crooked passage climbs back toward the door of bone and
iron.

22032.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach
22032.description:
The air grows hot and dry, tasting of iron. Torn banners hang in ragged
strips. A low vibration hums through the stone, like a drumbeat. The air
is thick and hard to breathe. Darkness clings to every surface.

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22037.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

extra_descs.vault: The vault feels endless, though its walls are visible. Sound dies before it reaches them.
extra_descs.braziers: The braziers are cold and empty, their fuel long since consumed.

22037.description:
A hollow vault absorbs every sound. The light dulls and fades, as if
consumed. The room feels vast, yet suffocating. The air is thick and
hard to breathe. Darkness clings to every surface.

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22033.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

extra_descs.throne: The throne is built from shattered weapons: swords, axes, spears, all fused in blood and fury.
extra_descs.blood: The blood on the floor is fresh and old at once, as if time itself bleeds here.

22033.description:
A blood‑slick floor surrounds a throne of weapons. The chamber reeks of
steel and sweat. The walls glow with a faint, angry crimson. The stone
walls press close, cold and damp. The silence is oppressive and
watchful.

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22036.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach
22036.description:
Blackened braziers line the passage, all cold. The scent of decay clings
to the air. The corridor feels starved of warmth and light. The air is
thick and hard to breathe. The silence is oppressive and watchful.

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22107.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22107.description:
The passage runs north and south through a hall of black stone, its
walls carved with rows of hollow-eyed faces. South the way leads among
cold, blackened braziers, while north the pathway continues into deeper
darkness. Grit and ash have drifted against the walls in long ridges.
The air is close and smells of stale smoke.

22108.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22108.description:
Iron spikes jut from the ceiling here, hanging like rows of black
icicles over the passage. The floor beneath them is clean, as if swept,
which is somehow worse than rubble. The pathway runs on north into
silence and south toward the hall of carved faces. A faint, chill
draught stirs the dust.

22164.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies The Rusted Grates.

22164.description:
The passage runs north and south here along a narrow ledge of solid
stone. To the west the floor becomes a lattice of iron grates laid over
a pit, rusted through and sagging. A hot, foul breath rises between the
bars. The ledge is worn smooth by the feet of those who knew better than
to step off it.

22165.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

north.description: To the north lies The Rider's Niche.

22165.description:
The passage turns a sharp corner here, and in the angle stands a statue
of an armoured rider on a gaunt horse, its stone arm raised. The way
bends from south to east around the statue's base. Behind it, to the
north, a dark niche opens in the wall, and from it comes the creak of a
hidden hinge. Dark stains spatter the plinth.

extra_descs.statue rider plinth:
The rider wears plate carved in fine detail, and its face is hidden
behind a closed helm. The iron sword in its fist is notched and dark
with old stains, but its hinge has rusted fast.

22109.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22109.description:
This chamber is a brief pause in the pathway's menace, a bare square
room with a domed roof lost in shadow. War trophies cover the walls:
broken helms, shields split down the middle, and the rusted heads of
pikes, all nailed fast to the stone. West a passage leads back toward
the statue of the rider, and north another opens into darkness. Ash has
settled thickly on every ledge.

22166.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

north.description: To the north lies Beneath The Propped Slab.

22166.description:
The passage runs from south to east here beneath a ceiling of solid
rock. To the north an opening leads under a slab of black stone held up
by wooden props, rotten and leaning. Splinters and grey dust spill out
across the floor. No one who knew this place would breathe hard beside
it.

22167.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies The Fuming Pit.

22167.description:
This long passage runs east and west, its walls furred with pale mold.
To the south, cracks in the floor open into a low side chamber where
thick, greenish fumes pool and stir. The air near it stings the eyes. A
line of old bones lies along the southern wall, swept aside by those who
came after.

22110.name: Pathway To Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22110.description:
Here the pathway reaches the foot of Ocam's Reach, where the castle's
stonework gives way to raw black rock cut through by hand. The wind can
be heard howling somewhere above, though no breath of it reaches this
place. North a passage rises into the promontory itself, and west the
way leads back toward the fumes. Rust-red streaks run down the rock like
old blood.

22169.name: Ocam's Reach

north.description: To the north lies Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Weapon's.

south.description: To the south lies Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Armor's.

22169.description:
Four ways meet in this cramped hall at the heart of Ocam's Reach, and
two of them are snares. East a doorway marked with a carved sword opens
onto Ocam's Weapon's, and west another, marked with a carved
breastplate, leads to Ocam's Armor's. North the corridor tightens among
spines of iron, and south it runs back the way it came. Scratched into
the floor by many hands is a single word: walk.

22111.name: Ocam's Reach
22111.description:
The corridor tightens, spines of iron jutting from the walls between
doorways to the east and west. Each doorway is framed in black iron, and
the air from each is cold and smells of metal. The stone bears fresh
gouges. The way runs on north and south between them.

north.description: To the north lies Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies A Room Of Iron Spines.

west.description: To the west lies The Narrow Vault.

22112.name: Ocam's Reach
22112.description:
The path widens into a bleak gallery of cracked stone. The light dulls
to a gray haze. The scent of oil and ash lingers. The stone walls press
close, cold and damp. Darkness clings to every surface.

north.description: To the north lies Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Inn.

south.description: To the south lies Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Bar.

22114.name: Ocam's Reach

extra_descs.throne: Kirgan's throne is a pile of shattered armor and broken bones, a monument to slaughter.
extra_descs.armor: Broken armor litters the floor, each piece a fallen champion.

22114.description:
A throne of broken armour stands in this ruin-stained chamber, where
Ocam's Reach runs north and south. Low doorways open east and west, each
filled with nothing but darkness and the smell of iron and smoke. This
place feels forged for slaughter. The floor is slick with moisture.

north.description: To the north lies Ocam's Reach.

south.description: To the south lies Ocam's Reach.

east.description: To the east lies The Furnace Cell.

west.description: To the west lies The Pit Of Swords.

22113.name: Ocam's Reach
22113.description:
A narrow stretch leads onward through hooked spikes and rubble. The
silence is heavy and absolute. The floor tilts slightly underfoot. The
silence is oppressive and watchful. The air is thick and hard to
breathe.

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Food's.

south.description: To the south lies Ocam's Reach.

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Magic's.

22170.name: Ocam's Weapon's
22170.description: You stumble into a deadly spike wall! There is no escape...

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Reach.

22172.name: Ocam's Inn
22172.description: You stumble into a deadly flame pit! There is no escape...

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Reach.

22174.name: Ocam's Food's

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Reach.

22174.description:
What was once a storeroom for food is now a cellar of rot, its shelves
collapsed under the weight of mold and black slime. The floor gives
under any foot like soft earth, and beneath the crust lies a vat of
something thick that swallows whatever falls in. A low doorway leads
back west into the Reach. The stench is overpowering.

22175.name: Ocam's Magic's

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Reach.

22175.description:
Shelves of shattered glass line this small chamber, and strange sigils
are painted in faded silver across its floor. The moment anything
crosses the sigils they flare white, and a searing blast of old sorcery
fills the room. A doorway opens back east into the Reach, scorched black
around its frame. The air crackles and smells of lightning.

extra_descs.sigils:
The sigils form a ring of linked hooks and eyes, painted in silver gone
dull. A few lines are scorched as if the paint itself once burned.

22173.name: Ocam's Bar

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Reach.

22173.description:
A long bar of black wood runs the length of this low room, its top
stained and split, and behind it stand casks with their staves burst.
The floorboards before the bar are rotten through, and they give way
over a cellar flooded with black, stagnant water. The only door leads
back east to the Reach. The sour smell of spilt wine and decay hangs
heavy.

22171.name: Ocam's Armor's

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Reach.

22171.description:
Empty armour stands in ranks around the walls of this narrow room, suits
of black plate propped on iron frames as if waiting for wearers. The
frames are linked by hidden chains, and at a touch the whole line
topples inward with a crash of steel. The doorway back east to the hall
of the Reach is the only way out. Rust lies thick upon every plate.

22189.name: A Tilting Floor

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

22189.description:
The opening leads into a pitch-black pocket of the bastion, and the
floor slopes treacherously under a slick of black ooze. Too late, a
flagstone shifts and tilts, tipping everything on it into a pit
bristling with iron stakes. The faint light of the doorway is suddenly
far out of reach. The stink of old death rises from below.

22190.name: A Falling Ceiling

east.description: To the east lies Pathway Around The Castle.

22190.description:
This chamber is so low that its ceiling of iron-banded stone almost
brushes the head. A grinding of hidden chains sounds in the walls as the
ceiling lurches and begins to descend. The doorway seems impossibly
distant behind. Dust sifts down in choking streams from the cracks
above.

22191.name: A Hollow Floor

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22191.description:
A few planks still span this alcove off the cutting, grey and rotten
over a shaft that drops into the dark. They crack the moment a foot
comes down, and the floor gives way all at once. The way back is only a
stride off, yet out of reach in the gloom. Far below, something waits on
the stones.

22192.name: The Iron-Plated Passage

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22192.description:
This passage is narrow and lined with plates of rusted iron, riveted
edge to edge from floor to ceiling. Each step presses a hidden plate,
and somewhere in the walls a mechanism clanks as rows of spikes shoot
out from the seams. The way back is lost in darkness. The air reeks of
old oil and rust.

22193.name: The Chute Of Blades

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22193.description:
The floor here is polished slick by something that oozes from the walls,
and it slopes away without warning. Hands find nothing to hold, and the
slope steepens into a chute that ends in a nest of upturned blades. The
passage above is gone in the dark. A sweet, rotten smell hangs over
everything.

22194.name: The Rusted Grates

east.description: To the east lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22194.description:
The floor of this chamber is a lattice of iron grates laid over a pit,
and the grates are rusted through. One by one they sag and snap under
any weight, spilling all upon them onto the spikes below. The ledge is a
stride away and no nearer. A hot, foul breath rises from the depths.

22195.name: The Rider's Niche

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22195.description:
A second rider stands in this cramped niche, carved like the one
outside, but its sword is real iron and hangs on a greased hinge. Step
beneath it and it swings down with the weight of a falling tree. The
passage is barely a stride behind. The floor is black with old blood.

22196.name: Beneath The Propped Slab

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22196.description:
The ceiling of this chamber is a single slab of black stone held up by
wooden props, rotten and leaning. A careless step jars them loose, and
the whole slab comes down with a roar that shakes the castle to its
roots. The way out is a black slot at the edge of sight. Splinters and
grey dust cover the floor.

22197.name: The Fuming Pit

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Ocam's Reach.

22197.description:
Thick, greenish fumes pool along the floor of this low chamber, rising
from cracks in the stone. The air burns the throat at the first breath
and seals it shut at the second. The passage outside blurs in the
poisoned haze. Mold furs the walls in pale, sickly patches.

22198.name: A Windswept Cell

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Reach.

22198.description:
Slits in the black rock open onto the howling sky, and the wind tears
through them with such force that it can hurl a body against the far
wall, where barbed iron hooks wait in rows. There is no handhold on the
smooth stone. The doorway is a stride away against the gale. Shrieking
gusts make thought nearly impossible.

22199.name: A Chamber Of Hooks

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Reach.

22199.description:
The far wall of this narrow chamber is hung from floor to ceiling with
barbed iron hooks, and many still hold rags and bones. A gust through a
slit in the rock throws anything that stands here hard against them. The
doorway is already out of reach behind you. The wind screams through the
slits without pause.

22200.name: A Room Of Iron Spines

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Reach.

22200.description:
Spines of iron jut from every wall of this small room, and the floor
tilts under any weight toward the longest of them. The doorway tips away
above you. The air is cold and metallic. Nothing that has slid here has
climbed back out.

22201.name: The Narrow Vault

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Reach.

22201.description:
This narrow vault has no floor beyond its threshold, only a black drop
lined with barbed rails that run down out of sight. A breath of cold air
rises from it. The doorway is the last solid stone, and it is already
behind you. The rails are polished bright by what has slid down them.

22202.name: The Furnace Cell

west.description: To the west lies Ocam's Reach.

22202.description:
Heat rolls out of the dark the moment you cross the threshold, and the
floor of this cell is an iron grate over a bed of coals that flares
white at any weight. Smoke fills the throat. The doorway is a pale
square behind the glare. The bars glow red beneath your feet.

22203.name: The Pit Of Swords

east.description: To the east lies Ocam's Reach.

22203.description:
The floor ends a single stride past the doorway, and below lies a pit
set thick with upturned swords, their edges still bright. The stone at
the lip is slick and slopes toward it. The only way out is behind you,
and the slope will not let you turn. Old armour lies broken on the
blades.

22204.name: The Hall Of Blades

north.description: To the north lies Pathway Around The Castle.

22204.description:
Thin wires stretched across the floor at ankle height trigger great
scything blades that swing out of slots in the walls. They come from
both sides at once and leave no gap between. The opening behind you is a
stride away and no help. Old stains blacken the stones underfoot.

22205.name: The Iron Maiden

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22205.description:
The narrow iron chamber is shaped like a standing coffin, its inner face
set with long spikes. The door swings shut behind you on its oiled
hinges, and the spikes close with it. There is no room to turn. The
darkness inside is complete.

22206.name: Under The Iron Slab

south.description: To the south lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22206.description:
The ceiling of this low chamber is a single slab of iron hung on chains
that run up into the dark. Scraps of crushed armour are pressed flat
into the floor beneath it like leaves in a book. A chain snaps with a
crack overhead, and the slab comes down. The doorway is gone in the
falling dark.

22207.name: The Creeping Walls

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22207.description:
This passage narrows until its walls almost brush your shoulders, and
those walls are not still. With a slow, grinding patience they creep
inward on hidden tracks, and the dust of their passage sifts down from
the ceiling. The stones are stained dark at the height of a man's chest.
The hall behind you seems very far off in the blackness.

22208.name: The Hall Of Spikes

north.description: To the north lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22208.description:
The walls of this narrow passage are pierced with hundreds of small
holes, and the floor is studded with pressure plates disguised as worn
flagstones. A plate sinks underfoot, and great counterweights shift
within the stone. Iron spikes shoot from every hole at once. The hall is
a stride behind and of no use.

22209.name: A Floor Of Rotten Planks

west.description: To the west lies Hall Along The Inner Wall.

22209.description:
The floor of this room is not stone at all but a skin of rotten planks
laid over a pit. They split beneath the first step and spill everything
upon them onto the upturned blades below. The doorway is a pale shape
above, out of reach. The creak of failing timber is the last sound in
the dark.

22030.name: gate guardian
22030.long_desc: A hulking guardian stands here, its form encased in dark metal.
22030.description: The guardian is a massive figure of shadow and iron, its eyes burning with cold fury. It shows no signs of life beyond the malevolent gleam in its gaze.

22031.name: gate guardian
22031.long_desc: A hulking guardian stands here, its form encased in dark metal.
22031.description: The guardian is a massive figure of shadow and iron, its eyes burning with cold fury. It shows no signs of life beyond the malevolent gleam in its gaze.

22040.name: undead guardian
22040.long_desc: An undead guardian shambles here, its eyes burning cold.
22040.description: This undead horror was once a soldier. Now it is only hunger and hate, bound to patrol these walls for eternity.

22100.name: Kirgan the Destroyer
22100.long_desc: Kirgan stands here, a mountain of muscle and murder.
22100.description: Kirgan the Destroyer is a towering figure of brutal power. His eyes hold nothing but contempt for the living. Scars crisscross his flesh like a map of violence.

phases.message: [31mKirgan roars with berserk fury! His attacks become frenzied![0m
