abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.telegraph: Kirgan focuses on his target with murderous intent!

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.telegraph: [33mKirgan slams the ground with tremendous force![0m

abilities.name: Berserk Flurry
abilities.telegraph: Kirgan's eyes go wild as he attacks with reckless abandon!

22070.name: Pestilence
22070.long_desc: Pestilence drifts here, a miasma of rot and plague.
22070.description: Pestilence is less a being than a presence, a cloud of sickness given form. Where it passes, life withers and hope dies.

abilities.name: Plague Touch
abilities.telegraph: Pestilence reaches out with diseased hands!

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.telegraph: A cloud of disease fills the room!

abilities.name: Plague Swarm
abilities.telegraph: Pestilence summons a swarm of diseased insects!

22071.name: War
22071.long_desc: War stands here, radiating fury and bloodlust.
22071.description: War is a figure of raw violence, muscles corded with rage. The air around it vibrates with the echoes of a thousand battles.

phases.message: [31mWar draws a second blade, doubling its fury![0m

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.telegraph: War points its blade at you!

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.telegraph: War lets out a deafening battle cry!

22072.name: Famine
22072.long_desc: Famine lingers here, a hollow echo of starvation.
22072.description: Famine is gaunt beyond reason, a skeletal presence that seems to drain warmth and sustenance from the air itself.

abilities.name: Wasting Touch
abilities.telegraph: Famine reaches out with emaciated hands!

abilities.name: Hunger Aura
abilities.telegraph: An overwhelming hunger fills the room!

22073.name: Death
22073.long_desc: Death waits here, silent and inevitable.
22073.description: Death is stillness incarnate. It does not move, yet it is everywhere. Its presence is a weight, a certainty, the end of all things.

phases.message: [31mDeath's eyes blaze with unholy fire! The dead begin to stir![0m
[31mDeath screams in fury! A wave of death energy erupts![0m

abilities.name: Death Touch
abilities.telegraph: Death reaches out with a skeletal hand...

abilities.name: Life Drain
abilities.telegraph: Death draws the life force from the room!

abilities.name: Summon Undead
abilities.telegraph: Death raises its hand and the dead answer!

abilities.name: Death Wave
abilities.telegraph: [31mDeath gathers an immense wave of necrotic energy![0m

22098.name: dying crusader
22098.long_desc: A crusader knight lies here against a blood-stained wall, his once-gleaming armor shattered.
22098.description: The holy symbols on his tabard are scorched and his sword lies broken beside him. Blood pools beneath him, but his eyes still burn with righteous fury. He doesn't have long.

talk_responses.hello: The knight coughs blood. 'Listen... carefully. The castle's master... is not what he seems. Layers of illusion... the throne room is a trap. The REAL power... is beneath. In the dungeons. A ritual circle... feeding the castle's darkness.' He grips your arm. 'Holy weapons. Blessed steel. Nothing else even scratches them. Promise me... you'll finish this.'
talk_responses.castle: He wheezes. 'We came with fifty knights. The outer ward fell in an hour. The demons came from everywhere — walls, floors, shadows. The bound ones are the worst... they WANT to be freed, and they'll say anything. Trust nothing that offers you power in this cursed place.'
talk_responses.default: The dying knight's breathing grows shallower. He murmurs a prayer through bloodied lips.
talk_responses.next: The crusader coughs blood but manages a grim smile. 'You've made it this far? You're among the greatest heroes the realm has ever known. Only the Tunnel of Sticks remains unconquered. May the gods have mercy on your soul.'

22099.name: bound demon
22099.long_desc: A demon is bound here within a circle of smoldering runes, its form writhing against invisible chains.
22099.description: It's beautiful and terrible — shifting between alluring and monstrous with each heartbeat. Its eyes are pools of liquid fire, and its smile promises everything while meaning nothing. The binding circle flickers dangerously.

talk_responses.hello: The demon's voice is silk and venom. 'Ah, a mortal. How delightful. I could offer you such things — power, knowledge, the location of every treasure in this castle. All I need is a small favor. Just... scuff one of these runes with your foot. Such a tiny thing. Barely even counts as a decision, really.'
talk_responses.bargain: It laughs like breaking glass. 'Everyone has a price. Yours is... hmm. Interesting. I can see your desires, mortal. But no, I won't name them aloud. That would be crass. Just know that everything you want is one scuffed rune away. Think about it.'
talk_responses.default: The demon watches you with burning eyes, its smile never wavering. The binding runes pulse in warning.

22050.name: apocalypse gate key
22050.room_desc: A heavy iron key lies here.

22051.name: inner gate key
22051.room_desc: A dark steel key lies here.

22060.name: ruinblade
22060.room_desc: A massive blade etched with ruin lies here.
22060.description: The ruinblade is a massive weapon of dark iron, its edge never dulling. Runes of destruction crawl along the blade, whispering of fallen kingdoms.

22061.name: apocalypse plate
22061.room_desc: A suit of apocalyptic plate lies here.
22061.description: This plate armor is forged from the ruins of fallen fortresses, each piece bearing the scars of apocalyptic battles.

22070.name: pestilence key
22070.room_desc: A corroded key weeps sickly green mist.

22080.name: plaguewrap
22080.room_desc: A shroud of diseased cloth lies here.

22081.name: pestilent ring
22081.room_desc: A ring oozing faint green vapor rests here.

22082.name: warbrand
22082.description: The warbrand is a brutal cleaver of crimson steel, built for devastation. It hums with the echoes of countless battles.

22083.name: pauldron of war
22083.room_desc: A massive crimson pauldron lies here.

22084.name: hunger chain
22084.room_desc: A chain of empty links lies here.

22085.name: gauntlets of famine
22085.room_desc: Gauntlets of cracked bone lie here.

22086.name: scythe of endings
22086.room_desc: A black scythe rests here, the air around it silent.
22086.description: The scythe of endings is a weapon of absolute finality, its blade black as the void. Where it cuts, nothing heals.

22087.name: veil of the end
22087.room_desc: A veil of night pools here.
22087.description: The veil is woven from shadow and silence, colder than death. It obscures the wearer from both sight and fate.

22088.name: death's ring
22088.room_desc: A ring cold as a grave lies here.
22088.description: This ring is cold to the touch, colder still to the soul. It belonged to Death itself, and carries a fragment of that finality.

22091.name: girdle of hunger
22091.room_desc: A cracked leather girdle lies here.

22092.name: mantle of the end
22092.room_desc: A heavy mantle of void cloth lies here.

22071.name: war key
22071.room_desc: A key stamped with a war sigil lies here.

22001.name: death's black armor
22001.room_desc: Armor of pure darkness lies here.

22002.name: war helm of the apocalypse
22002.short_desc: a war helm of the apocalypse
22002.room_desc: A helm of apocalyptic war lies here.

22003.name: pestilence cloak
22003.room_desc: A cloak reeking of plague lies here.

22004.name: famine ring
22004.room_desc: A ring of endless hunger lies here.

22110.name: warlord bearskin war-helm
22110.room_desc: A war-helm made from a great bear's head lies here, its teeth still bared.
22110.description: The whole head of a great cave bear, cured hard and lined with an iron cap, its jaws framing the wearer's face. Whoever killed it did so alone.

22111.name: warlord blackened plate cuirass
22111.room_desc: A dented cuirass of blackened plate lies here.
22111.description: Heavy plates of blackened steel over a coat of red leather, every dent left unhammered as a tally of the blows it turned.

22112.name: warlord blackened steel vambraces
22112.short_desc: a pair of the Warlord's blackened steel vambraces
22112.room_desc: A pair of black steel vambraces lies here.
22112.description: Vambraces of blackened steel, scarred along the outer edge where they have caught a hundred blades.

22113.name: warlord blackened steel gauntlets
22113.short_desc: a pair of the Warlord's blackened steel gauntlets
22113.room_desc: A pair of heavy black gauntlets lies here.
22113.description: Gauntlets of blackened steel, the knuckles studded, the palms worn smooth by the grip of a greatsword.

22114.name: warlord blackened steel greaves
22114.short_desc: a pair of the Warlord's blackened steel greaves
22114.room_desc: A pair of black steel greaves lies here.
22114.description: Greaves of blackened steel that ring when struck, buckled over legs of red leather.

22115.name: warlord blackened steel sabatons
22115.short_desc: a pair of the Warlord's blackened steel sabatons
22115.room_desc: A pair of black steel sabatons lies here.
22115.description: Sabatons of blackened steel, toes capped and soles nailed for the mud of a battlefield.

22116.name: warlord wolf-pelt cloak fur
22116.room_desc: A heavy cloak of grey wolf pelts lies here.
22116.description: Three great wolf pelts stitched into one cloak, the heads still on, their jaws clasped at the wearer's shoulders.

22117.name: warlord war-belt
22117.room_desc: A wide belt of red leather, hung with trophies, lies here.
22117.description: A wide war-belt of red leather and iron plates, hung with the teeth and rings of beaten champions.

22120.name: black lotus masked cowl hood
22120.room_desc: A deep cowl of purple-black silk, a mask of the same cloth hanging from it, lies here.
22120.description: A deep cowl of silk the colour of a bruise, with a mask of the same cloth that covers the face below the eyes. A black lotus is embroidered at the brow; Death sends those who wear it ahead of him.

22121.name: black lotus leather armor
22121.room_desc: A suit of black leather, oiled silent, lies here.
22121.description: Black leather oiled until it makes no sound at all, with sheaths sewn inside the lining for six knives.

22122.name: black lotus wrist-wraps
22122.short_desc: a pair of the Black Lotus wrist-wraps
22122.room_desc: A pair of black silk wrist-wraps lies here.
22122.description: Long wraps of black silk wound from wrist to elbow, a garrotte wire hidden in each.

22123.name: black lotus gloves leather
22123.short_desc: a pair of the Black Lotus gloves
22123.room_desc: A pair of thin black gloves lies here.
22123.description: Gloves of thin black leather, the fingertips stained with something that is not ink.

22124.name: black lotus leather breeches
22124.short_desc: a pair of the Black Lotus leather breeches
22124.room_desc: A pair of black leather breeches lies here.
22124.description: Breeches of black leather, close-fitting and silent.

22125.name: black lotus soft boots
22125.short_desc: a pair of the Black Lotus soft boots
22125.room_desc: A pair of soft black boots lies here.
22125.description: Boots of black felt over leather soles, made to cross a marble floor without a whisper.

22126.name: black lotus shroud cloak
22126.room_desc: A long purple-black shroud lies here like a pool of shadow.
22126.description: A long shroud of purple-black silk that drinks the light around it and trails to the ground; in a dim room the eye slides off it.

22127.name: black lotus poisoner belt
22127.room_desc: A belt of small black vials lies here.
22127.description: A belt of black leather lined with tiny stoppered vials, each one marked with a lotus petal.
